task.name: Codebase Audit & Remediation Directives
task.violation: Eradicate arbitrary bracket values (e.g., .mb-[13rem]); enforce centralized Tailwind configuration intervals.
Halt embedded script payloads dumping serialized JSON; decouple hydration to unfreeze main threads.
Remove `outline:none` lacking fallbacks; enforce high-visibility focus rings across interactive elements.
Mandate `rel="noopener noreferrer"` on all `target="_blank"` anchors to neutralize reverse tabnabbing vulnerabilities.
Implement strict backend DTOs to strip raw CMS identifiers, DB UUIDs, and unfiltered schema objects prior to client serialization.
